scope: Migration-specific host recovery following an ACL preflight refusal. This is an intentional additional tool, not an upstream parity claim or a new accepted Source exception signature.
implementation: Host-only inspect/plan/repair tool mounted through sandbox service injection in both canonical one-shot and persistent pwsh consumers; tool scope cleanup verified.
Read-only diagnosis survives a blocked workspace shell and reports directory and ancestor ACLs without materializing grants.
Plan binds workspace, session, host account, original descriptor and directory identity chain; expires after 600 seconds, bounded to 16 plans.
Only allowed-once approval applies a current-host-account inheritable Modify grant to the explicitly selected directory. Existing ACEs are preserved rather than merged through same-SID GRANT_ACCESS.
Host metadata handles enforce READ_CONTROL/WRITE_DAC without enabling privileges; x86 and x64 layouts exercised on actual Windows.
Backup is flushed, synchronized and reopened before application; stale snapshots, failed backup, cancellation and read-only policies prevent mutation.

Post-apply validation reports workspace readiness separately from selected-directory repair; protected descendants are not reset. Parent approval explicitly discloses propagation to other inheriting workspaces.

targeted_runs.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_windows_acl_recovery.py tests/test_workspace_acl_tool.py tests/test_windows_acl_materialization.py tests/test_windows_acl_runner.py tests/test_local_sandbox_provider.py tests/test_pwsh_executor.py tests/test_canonical_pwsh_tool.py tests/test_canonical_persistent_pwsh.py tests/test_fs_atomic_write_diagnostics.py tests/1to1/sandbox -q --tb=short --junitxml=.goose/out/acl-recovery-20261021-final-v2-targeted.xml
targeted_runs.coverage: Recovery and approval negatives, real restricted Python nested Markdown reopen/delete, actual persistent PowerShell refusal-to-recovery journey, canonical Web Minimal/Standard scoped diagnosis, shell and filesystem consumers, previous preflight/runner regressions.

targeted_runs.selection: tests/test_windows_acl_recovery.py tests/test_workspace_acl_tool.py -k 'not persistent and not actual_web'
targeted_runs.bootstrap: Temporarily prepend .venv/Lib/site-packages and repository root to this isolated interpreter process's sys.path; no runtime files changed.
targeted_runs.coverage: Native metadata layout, this-folder-only and capability-only recovery, parent propagation and protected descendants, stale/foreign/expired plans, backup and post-apply failures, Deny/NULL/empty refusal, reparse refusal and approval consumers. PTY and actual Web journey were exercised by x64 only.

paired_regression.note: The existing two exact predicates remain unchanged. The additional recovery tool is not accepted through this predicate.

limitations: Modern Windows build 26200; no Win7 SP1 domain/LDAP-account qualification or real user E-drive mutation.
Only selected directories can be repaired; old protected files and all descendant access are not certified. NULL, absent and empty DACLs require manual review.
Windows can propagate inheritable permissions below a selected parent. The saved selected-directory descriptor is not a whole-tree rollback or SACL backup.
No repair without allowed-once approval or adequate host permissions; no UAC elevation, arbitrary shell recovery or automatic unconfined fallback.
Raw local reports are ignored working outputs, not a release evidence archive. Original preflight records retain their original inputs.
No full regression, Portable/Desktop rebuild or release qualification; the existing released artifacts do not contain these source changes.
